newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields move up on latest Saudi treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields move up on latest Saudi treasury bills.

text.p: Yields were higher at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills climbed to 5.8147 percent from 5.7890 and the rate on 91-day paper rose to 5.8811 percent from 5.8572 last week, bankers in the kingdom said on Tuesday.
The 182-day bills yielded 6.0027 percent from 5.9207 and the rate on 364-day bills was 6.1905 percent, up from 6.1731.
One-month interbank deposits were 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, three months were six, 5-7/8 percent, six months were 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year funds were at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.54981, 98.53516, 97.05469 and 94.10938 respectively.
